text: Yes, I ratify AJG as WATCH on reclaim:ma_20 (H1). My OBJECT was to in_zone:ma_20 'then buy there': a resting buy that bets on two moves when one can be projected (C12). reclaim:ma_20 asks the market to pull back into the zone and then close back above it on the hourly: follow-through is required before entry, which is what my would_clear asked for. The 20-day pullback is an allowed trend entry (C7, C3). Still SUPPORT. Wrong if: close back under structure_shift_ref by half an ATR, or a bearish change of character.
what_moved_me: The trigger word itself: reclaim:ma_20 (H1) requires an hourly close back above ma_20 after the pullback, a confirmed turn rather than a resting buy at the zone; that clears my C12 objection to in_zone:ma_20.
